note: Superior National Forest (Tofte district) rustic campground on the open fields of an abandoned farm beside Harriet Lake, on County Road 7 between Isabella and Finland, with a boat ramp and dock and a large open area for group picnics. Pull-in sites not designed for RVs: four of the six are longer than 21 ft and may take a 23-ft rig. No garbage pickup: pack everything out. --Claude
summary: FS page read: 6 sites (4 over 21 ft), free, FCFS (no rec.gov listing), vault toilet, no water, 9 people, season May 8-Oct 1 written. Not waterfront kept. Pin is the FS boat-ramp point ~275 m from the campground field. Phone missing.

The six sites are not numbered or placed on any FS map, so no site can be named near the water. No upgrade.
